description: Approved values for the metadata.aws-devops-agent-skills.* dimensions, which skill catalogs such as GitHub Pages show as filters. A value not listed here is an error; a pull request that needs a new value adds it here, where a maintainer reviews it. A placeholder such as All, Any, None, N/A, Other, General or *, in any case, can never be approved: the check refuses to run if values or aliases list one. aliases maps a value that isn't approved to the approved spelling the check suggests instead. agent-types is absent on purpose: it sets which agents load the skill, so its values are the API values in agent-types.json and an unknown one is an error.
